# Power steering reservoir capacity

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

A full bottle of fluid is poured into the reservoir, with extra in the rear for topping off. [t2289]

[Partial] Leaking fluid on the outside indicates a power steering reservoir crack where tightening clamps may fail. [t2289]

## Parts

- Reservoir: Holds enough fluid to fill the box and back seat.; Cracks often appear right where the hose clamp sits. [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- A full bottle of fluid can be poured into the reservoir, with extra in the rear for topping off. [t2289]
- Leaking fluid on the outside of the container is a common symptom. [t2289]
- Tightening clamps here can be ineffective if the rubber has hardened. [t2289]
